title: FSAMP Secure Event
description: Standard event definition for FSAMP platform file processing flow. FIPS 140-3-oriented cryptographic requirements.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema for forward compatibility.

fileId.description: Stable aggregate identifier for the file across all services (UUID v4 format).

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event occurrence (UUID v4 format).

correlationId.description: Trace ID used to track the request across microservices (UUID v4 format).

source.description: Identifier of the service that produced this event.

eventType.description: Discriminator for the type of event action.

fileMetadata.description: Business metadata regarding the processed file.

originalFilename.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file content.

checksumSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of file content for integrity verification (FIPS 180-4).

storageLocation.description: Pointer to the physical storage location (Claim-Check Pattern).

objectKey.description: S3 object key (path) within the bucket.

region.description: AWS region where the bucket is located.

securityContext.description: Cryptographic metadata required by the FSAMP FIPS 140-3-oriented security posture.

isEncrypted.description: Whether the file is encrypted at rest.

encryptionAlgorithm.description: FIPS 140-3-oriented encryption algorithm constraint. Only AES-256-GCM is permitted (NIST SP 800-38D).

kmsKeyId.description: ARN of the AWS KMS key used for envelope encryption.
